integrity_statement: A direct all-parameter proof is supplied; recorded finite enumeration and occurrence scans are corroboration, not substitutes for the unbounded proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to positive-parameter symmetric binary five-run palindromes; it does not classify all five-run words or all optimal position sets. A search of indexed and accessible works is not a global uniqueness certificate.
title: String-attractor phase transition in symmetric five-run binary palindromes
